questions.prompt: A weekly web research task must run while your laptop is closed. Where should it run?

options.explanation: Right. OpenAI says cloud is useful for scheduled tasks that check websites, because your computer doesn't need to be awake.
A local task needs your computer on. Choose local for files and tools on your computer.

options.text: Either; both run with the laptop shut
options.explanation: Local steps need the computer online. Only the cloud keeps going without it.

options.text: Hidden orders in content the agent reads
options.explanation: Right. Anthropic's example is an email that says to ignore earlier instructions and send money.

options.text: A setting that adds admin rules to prompts
options.explanation: That is not prompt injection. Injection comes from untrusted content the agent reads.

options.text: A safety check that blocks unsafe actions
options.explanation: That describes a safeguard, not the attack.

questions.prompt: On a Claude Team plan, Anthropic's mode for a task that could send messages as you is…

options.explanation: Nothing checks the actions in Skip mode. Anthropic says to use Manually approve when mistakes are hard to undo.
Right. Anthropic lists sending messages as a hard-to-undo case for Manually approve.

options.text: Any mode; messages always need approval
options.explanation: Anthropic says Claude always asks before permanently deleting files. It says no such thing for every message.
